svg.title: Distribution of state-race polling errors
svg.desc: 34 qualifying Senate and governor races: 30 positive errors and four negative errors. Dots are stacked in two-point error bands. Positive errors mean polls understated Democrats. The dashed line marks the supplied mean of 5.3 points; hollow dots are uncalled races.
svg.text: 34 Senate and governor races | 30 positive errors, 4 negative errors
